items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But we finally made it on to the club and then we jammed all the rest of the night.

ctx.x: I said, ―Don‘t bother him!‖ I said, ―He‘s drunk. Don‘t…‖ They were drunk, they were trying to waste him, man. I said, ―Don‘t pay him no attention.‖ Because he was high, you know. But we finally made it on to the club and then we jammed all the rest of the night. [laughs]
[laughs] But as far as what you were talking about as far as tone and sound Freddie pretty much had it all, huh?
